description:
pkix-revocation/src/ocsp.rs: Steps 1-5 of check_revocation (parse outer response, check Successful, extract responseBytes, check responseType, parse BasicOcspResponse, verify signature) are ~40 lines duplicated nearly verbatim in check_revocation_against_anchor.

Extract a helper: fn parse_and_verify_basic_response<V>(response_der, verifier, issuer_spki) -> Result<BasicOcspResponse>

Both callers then diverge only for the ResponderId verification and CertID hash check.
title: M6: OCSP parse+verify steps duplicated between check_revocation and check_revocation_against_anchor
